scenario.topic: Agree on the theme for the hackathon weekend

options.name: Sustainable Tech Innovations
options.upside: Encourages projects with positive environmental effects.
options.concern: May limit interest for participants less familiar with sustainability topics.

options.name: AI for Everyday Life
options.upside: Supports innovative AI applications that improve daily routines.
options.concern: Could be challenging for participants new to AI concepts.

options.name: Health Tech and Wellness
options.upside: Promotes projects that can impact personal health positively.
options.concern: May require domain knowledge that not all participants possess.

options.name: Smart Cities and Urban Solutions
options.upside: Encourages diverse projects addressing city living challenges.
options.concern: Could involve complex integration of multiple technologies.

shared_context: The group of 7 participants needs to select a theme for the upcoming hackathon weekend. The theme should inspire creativity, be relevant to current technology trends, and allow diverse project ideas.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a healthcare software developer passionate about wellness technology.
personas.private_goal: To promote projects that improve personal health and wellness.

A.reason_for: Supports environmental impact which aligns with wellness and sustainability.
A.reason_against: May be less directly related to health tech than preferred option.

B.reason_for: AI has broad applications, including health, but complexity is high.
B.reason_against: Software-only focus limits hardware wearables integration.

C.reason_for: Directly promotes healthcare technology and wearable devices, matching Maya's expertise.

D.reason_for: Urban solutions can include health-related projects.
D.reason_against: Complex integration and less focus on personal health.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a data scientist interested in AI applications for practical use.
personas.private_goal: To push for innovative AI projects that improve everyday life.

A.reason_for: Sustainability is important but less aligned with Liam's AI focus.
A.reason_against: May limit interest due to hardware/software mix and less AI focus.

B.reason_for: High relevance of AI and supports innovative software projects.
B.reason_against: Challenging for newcomers, but Liam is experienced.

C.reason_for: Health tech is a growing field where AI can be applied effectively.

D.reason_for: Smart cities involve tech innovation but less AI-centric.
D.reason_against: Complex integration may slow down project progress.

personas.private_goal: To ensure the hackathon theme allows impactful health and wellness projects.
